description: WEKA LWH Exporter v2 (/api/v3/clusters/<id>/stats/prometheus/v2). Every v2 metric is a pre-computed rate or average - use it directly, never wrap it in rate(). Every query is wrapped in max by (<identity labels>) to collapse duplicate scrapes. Reference: https://docs.weka.io/monitor-the-weka-cluster/the-wekaio-support-cloud/export-cluster-metrics-to-prometheus

panels.description: Value is 1 for OK/REBUILDING/REDISTRIBUTING; the status label carries the real state.
panels.title: Cluster Status

panels.description: ETH = Ethernet, IB = InfiniBand
panels.title: Link Layer

targets.expr: sum(max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, status) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster",role="frontend"}))
sum(max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, status) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster",role="compute"}))
sum(max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, status) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster",role="drives"}))

panels.description: Active drives emit no series, so anything above 0 is a failed or removed drive.

targets.expr: count(max by (server_name, disk_id, serial, model, target_state) (weka_drive_inactive{cluster_name=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Inactive Drives

targets.expr: count(count by (server_name) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, status) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster",mode="backend"})))
count(count by (server_name) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, status) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster",mode="client"})))

panels.description: POSIX Driver layer, all protocols. Already a rate - no rate() applied.
panels.title: Throughput

targets.expr: count(count by (server_name) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, status) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster"})))
sum(max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, status) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster"}))

(max(weka_cluster_read_ops_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0)) + (max(weka_cluster_write_ops_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(max by (op_type) (weka_cluster_metadata_ops_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0))

panels.description: num_failures=0 means fully protected. Below 100% there means data at risk.
panels.title: Protection Status

panels.description: le is already in seconds. Windowed values - no rate() before histogram_quantile().
panels.title: Read Latency Percentiles

panels.description: All 5 severities are emitted, including zeros.
panels.title: Alerts by Severity

panels.description: Already an average - never wrap in rate().
panels.title: Average Latency

panels.description: Subtract from Average Latency to get latency without the QoS contribution.
panels.title: QoS Throttle Delay

targets.expr: sum by (container_id, server_name, container_name, role) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster", status="active"})
sum by (container_id, server_name, container_name, role) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster", status="total"})
sum by (server_name, mode) (weka_container_process_count{cluster_name=~"$cluster", mode="backend", mode!="CLIENT", status="active"})
count(count by (server_name) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, op_type) (weka_posix_client_metadata_ops_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster"})))
avg by (server_name) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, process_id) (weka_cpu_utilization_percent{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client",mode=~"CLIENT"}))
topk(10, max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role) (weka_cpu_utilization_percent{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server=~"$client",mode=~"CLIENT"}))
sum by (op_type) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, op_type) (weka_posix_client_metadata_ops_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"}))
avg by (op_type) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, op_type) (weka_posix_client_metadata_latency_seconds_avg{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"}))
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_read_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_read_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_read_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_read_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_read_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.999, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_read_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_write_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.75, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_write_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_write_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_write_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_write_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
histogram_quantile(0.999, sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_write_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"})))
sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_read_size_bytes_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"}))
sum by (le) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, le) (weka_posix_client_write_size_bytes_bucket{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$client"}))

panels.description: Non-zero means this client is being throttled by QoS.
panels.title: Client QoS Throttle Delay

panels.description: Already averaged over the rate window - use directly, no rate().
panels.title: CPU Utilization by Role (avg)

targets.expr: topk(20, max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, process_id) (weka_cpu_utilization_percent{cluster_name=~"$cluster",mode!="CLIENT"}))
avg by (server_name) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role, process_id) (weka_cpu_utilization_percent{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server",mode!="CLIENT"}))
sum by (server_name, container_name, role) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, role) (weka_container_pending_ios_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"}))
sum by (server_name) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode) (weka_server_network_receive_bytes_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"}))
sum by (server_name) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode) (weka_server_network_transmit_bytes_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"}))

panels.description: error_type = errors | missed | no_mbufs

targets.expr: sum by (server_name, error_type) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode, error_type) (weka_server_network_receive_errors_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"}))

panels.title: Network RX Errors

targets.expr: sum by (server_name) (max by (server_name, container_id, container_name, mode) (weka_server_network_transmit_errors_per_second{cluster_name=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"}))

panels.description: Only emitted when the cluster has tiered filesystems; shows 0 when there are none.
panels.title: OBS Active Buckets

targets.expr: sum by (fs_name) (max by (fs_name, fs_id, capacity_type) (weka_filesystem_capacity_bytes{cluster_name=~"$cluster",fs_name=~"$fs", capacity_type="total"}))
sum by (fs_name, capacity_type) (max by (fs_name, fs_id, capacity_type) (weka_filesystem_capacity_bytes{cluster_name=~"$cluster",fs_name=~"$fs"}))
sum by (fs_name, capacity_type) (max by (fs_name, fs_id, capacity_type) (weka_filesystem_capacity_bytes{cluster_name=~"$cluster",fs_name=~"$fs",capacity_type=~"ssd_used"}))

sum by (fs_name) (max by (fs_name, fs_id) (weka_filesystem_capacity_bytes{cluster_name=~"$cluster",fs_name=~"$fs",capacity_type="used"})) - on(fs_name) sum by (fs_name) (max by (fs_name, fs_id) (weka_filesystem_capacity_bytes{cluster_name=~"$cluster",fs_name=~"$fs",capacity_type="ssd_used"}))

sum by (fs_name) (max by (fs_name, fs_id) (weka_filesystem_capacity_bytes{cluster_name=~"$cluster",fs_name=~"$fs",capacity_type="total"})) - on(fs_name) sum by (fs_name) (max by (fs_name, fs_id) (weka_filesystem_capacity_bytes{cluster_name=~"$cluster",fs_name=~"$fs",capacity_type="ssd_total"}))

sum by (fs_name) (max by (fs_name, fs_id) (weka_filesystem_capacity_bytes{cluster_name=~"$cluster",fs_name=~"$fs",capacity_type="used"})) / on(fs_name) sum by (fs_name) (max by (fs_name, fs_id) (weka_filesystem_capacity_bytes{cluster_name=~"$cluster",fs_name=~"$fs",capacity_type="total"}))
